additional_concerns: No executable meaning is supplied. The structural tool's UNSUPPORTED result establishes neither preservation nor a code defect.

The candidate's three-part formulation is an interpretation, not an express exhaustive test in paragraph 10. Effective supervision must not become an independently conclusive safe harbour or an unsupported additional requirement.

Section 6.11C concerns third-party valuation. Its reasonable-care and supervision standard cannot automatically govern tokenisation responsibility. Paragraph 13 concerns specified intermediary issuance activities and requires its own applicability assessment.

The supplied section 6.8 permits register maintenance by specified parties; this does not displace the Product Provider's retained responsibility. Register-location notification is a separate obligation.
Paragraph 15's requested audit or verification and paragraph 16's requested legal opinion are distinct from paragraph 14 confirmation and demonstration. None alone establishes substantive fulfilment.

The applicable Part A Appendix factors, complete relevant paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2, and actual provider evidence are not supplied. Incident materiality, assessment period and remediation effects remain unresolved; neither strict liability for every incident nor a universal reasonable-care safe harbour is established.
